item.title: SCOTT IN CHARGE
item.description: CALUM SCOTT will be in charge of Celtic’s Premiership encounter with Livingston at Parkhead tomorrow night. item.title: ‘NONSENSE,’ FALKIRK BOSS RUBBISHES MILLER CLAIM
item.description: FALKIRK boss John McGlynn has labelled claims that Calvin Miller was on the brink of a deadline-day return to Celtic as “nonsense”. Former Hoops defender Charlie Mulgrew stated he reckoned the left-sided forward was on Martin O’Neill’s wanted list and was being lined to rejoin the club he left in 2020. item.title: ‘IT WAS SAD,’ TAYLOR OPENS UP ON CELTIC EXIT
item.description: GREG TAYLOR admits he was sad on the day his six-year Celtic career came to an end. The 28-year-old left-back wanted to say farewell to the fans in style with a rousing send off in the Scottish Cup Final against Aberdeen at Hampden in May last year. item.title: GREEN LIGHT FOR TIERNEY, OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN?
item.description: KIERAN TIERNEY is likely to be in his usual No.3 slot when Celtic take on Livingston in the must-win Premiership encounter at Parkhead tomorrow night.
